events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Gulf Waters from East Cape Sable to Chokoloskee 20 to 60 nm out and
beyond 5 fathoms...

* Until 1030 AM EDT.

* At 1002 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 9 nm east of T
Tower, moving north at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1100 AM EDT.

* At 959 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from 16 nm south of
C Tower to 31 nm southwest of S Tower, moving northeast at 10
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats...damage
vessels...and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34
knots...suddenly higher waves...frequent lightning...and
heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Severe thunderstorms will remain over mainly open waters.

events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Georgia...

Satilla River At Atkinson affecting Brantley County.

Additional information is available at
https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX

The next statement will be issued Monday morning at 945 AM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Satilla River at Atkinson.

* WHEN...Until Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Warners Landing, Louis Landing and
secondary roads around KOA campgrounds begin to flood. At 14.0
feet, River Rock Road begins to experience flooding across the
road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 AM EDT Sunday the stage was 13.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 11.9 feet Wednesday
morning.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWGUM

The National Weather Service in Tiyan has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Saipan...
Tinian...

* Until 130 AM ChST.

* At 1126 PM ChST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain across the
warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts of 2 to 4 inches are possible in the warned area.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Garapan, Dandan, China Town, Tanapag, As Mahetog, Koblerville, San
Jose (Tinian Municipality), Chalan Kanoa I, San Antonio, Chalan
Kanoa II, Chalan Kanoa III, San Roque, Kagman, Chalan Kanoa IV,
Kagman III, Gualo Rai, Afetnas, Chalan Piao, Fananganan and Chalan
Laulau.
